messages: Oh my god. Oh my GOD. I just got the email.
I got in. I actually got in. Full scholarship to the program I've been dreaming about for three years.
I'm shaking. I literally cannot stop shaking and smiling at the same time.
I called my mom and she started crying. I started crying. We were both just crying on the phone.
I keep re-reading the email to make sure it's real. It's real. It's really real.
I want to thank everyone who helped me get here. My advisor who believed in me when I didn't believe in myself.
This is the proudest moment of my life. I worked so hard for this and it paid off.
I'm going to make the most of every single day of this opportunity.
Thank you, thank you, thank you. I am so incredibly grateful.
I can't wait to start. The best chapter of my life is just beginning.
